title: Riwayate Muqtaar
body:
Lyrics
Haay .. Ae Rone Walo Hai Yeh Riwayat Me Likha.
Jis Dam Qayam Koofe Me Mukhtar Ne Kiya.
Jo Bhi The Qatilane Shaheedane Karbala (A.s.), Are Unme Se Koi Jab Bhi Gireftar Hota Tha.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hukme Ameer Par Wo Sitam Jab Sunata Tha
Mukhtar Sar Ko Peetke Bus Rota Jaata Tha.
Haay.. Ek Roz Tha Ye Koofe Ke Darbaar Ka Sama, Ibne Numair (L.a.) Apne Sitam Karta Tha Bayaa.
Todi Thi Maine Sinae Akbar (A.s.) Me Khud Sina, Uthta Tha Shor Khaimo Se Maara Gaya Jawaa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Jiteji Guzar Gai, Zainab (S.a.) Bhi Margai
Ek Barchi Mere Kitne Jigar Paar Kargai.
Haay.. Ek Roz Karke Laaya Gaya Hurmala (L.a.) Aseer, Bola Wo Ran Me Maine Chalaye The Teen Teer
Us Waqt Pehla Teer Chalaya Tha Ae Ameer, Bhar Kar Chala Jo Mashk Toh Mazloom Ka Safeer (A.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Mashkeeze Se Jo Teer Mera Paar Hogaya
Aisa Laga Ke Qatl Alamdar (A.s.) Hogaya.
Haay.. Bola Laee Ye Karb Ka Hai Dusra Maqaam, Laaye Jo Apni God Me Besheer (A.s.) Ko Imaam (A.s.), Sukhi Zaba Phirata Tha Hoto Pe Tishnakaam
Hil Hil Gaya Lahad Me Jigar Buturab (A.s.) Ka , Are Maqtal Me Neher Hogaya Bacha Rabab (S.a.) Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Haay.. Darbar Me Ye Sunke Qayamat Ka Tha Samaa
Are Peero Jawaan Rote The Lele Ke Hichkiya
Bola Ye Hurmula (L.a.) Abhi Baaqi Hai Dastaa
Jis Dam Tera Husain (A.s.) Tha Teero Ke Darmiyaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Teer Aakhri Tha Jo Maine Chalaya Tha
Arey Us Teer Ne Husain (A.s.) Ko Zee Se Giraya Tha
Haay.. Phir Shor Wa Husaina (A.s.) Ka Uthta Tha Baar Baar
Jab Qaid Karke Laya Gaya Shimre(L.a.)Bad Sheyaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bola Wo Mere Haath Me Khanjar Tha Tez Dhaar
Jisse Kiye Husain (A.s.) Ki Gardan Pe Tera(13) Waar
Khanjar Rawa Tha Halq Pe Ibne Batool (A.s.) Ke
Dil Kat Rahe The Saath Me Aale Rasool (A.s.)Ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haay.. Ab Iske Baad Meer Takallum Baya Ho Kya
Ae Pursadaro Sochna Dil Me Kabhi Zara Kyu Itna Waqt Qatile Shabbir Ko Laga
Kis Waste Husain (A.s.) Ka Katta Na Tha Gala
Mehsher Me Ye Khulega Sitam Kaynaat Par
<<DIVIDER>>
Khanjar Ke Kuch Nishaan Hai Zahra (S.a.) Ke Haath Par
